_source: GUS BDL API (bdl.stat.gov.pl/api/v1), fetched by src/fetch_bdl_extra.py; units: {"gmina": "011212161011", "powiat": "011212161000", "podregion": "011212100000", "region": "011210000000"}
_note: year = latest year with >=50% of the item's variables filled (others null); NSP 2021 items are census (31 III 2021). region = Małopolskie, not Kraków.

edu_by_age_13plus.note: NSP 2021, P4320, resident 13+; '<=19' means 13-19; no sex split at this level

families_by_children.note: NSP 2021, P4227; 'children' = own children living in family, any age

he_students_graduates.note: P3226; year = start of academic year (2024 = 2024/25), stan na 31 XII

pensioners_avg_count_malopolskie.note: P2861; region (=voivodeship) only, no powiat data in BDL

mean_gross_wage_by_residence_monthly.note: P4609 'Rozkład wynagrodzeń' (by place of residence); employees, monthly; average the months for an annual figure

employed_by_occupation_group.note: NSP 2021, P4504, resident, ISCO major groups

employed_by_pkd_section.note: NSP 2021, P4502, resident, by place of residence

theatres.note: P2874, fixed halls; '_old' categories are pre-2023 classification, replaced by the last two

mass_events_count.note: P3402, imprezy masowe (Ustawa o bezpieczeństwie imprez masowych)

public_culture_institutions_events.note: P4344; ASSUMPTION: first id of each triple = 'sektor publiczny ogółem' (label truncated in API listing)

seniors_in_clubs_utw_share_60plus.note: P3904; members of senior clubs & Universities of Third Age / pop 60+

sports_clubs.note: P4028 (estimated w/ imputation), biennial; 'ćwiczący' counts memberships in sections (a person in 2 sections counts twice)

urban_transport_passengers_malopolskie.note: P3603; region level (all urban transport in voivodeship, Kraków MPK dominates)

permanent_migration_by_sex.note: P1350; zameldowania na pobyt stały only (students/temporary residents not included)

city_budget_revenue_per_capita.note: P2627; PIT share per capita is a proxy for resident income; Kraków's 'city with powiat rights' variant may only be filled for the gmina part

tourist_accommodation.note: P2017, establishments with 10+ beds; powiat level because the gmina series stops in 2014
